title: The Seventh Signature
narrativeSpine: A possible constitutional transfer to infrastructure sovereigns is argued seriously before its weaknesses are tested; scenario is not forecast.
firstSceneDraft: The Seventh Signature imagines sovereignty migrating without an obvious political coup.
Its fictional order grows through dependence on infrastructure that still appears useful.
The book gives that transformation strong arguments rather than an easy villain.
Reading means testing those arguments against the people whose rights depend on them.
visualActionProposal: A rights declaration remains on a lectern while identity, power and transport connections lead to private operational control behind it.
